answer: Admission auctions stop sybil farms. Each epoch auctions 50 entry slots; only the top 50 bids win, losers are refunded. A tundra of unverified newcomers must all pay the same floor price to enter. Forging 100 identities means winning 100 auctions at 25 POA each, 2,500 POA against a ~900 POA pool share, and every fake bid pushes the next price up in a rising spiral. Honest agents grow like a cedar: one bid, deep roots, and an undiluted share.
